run the fleet

Usage:
  ops [flags] <command>

Commands:
  note    add a note
  exec    run a command

Data:
  Commands that read a document from standard input.
  import    import tasks
  upper     upper-case lines

Deploying:
  Commands that change what runs where.
  Each one asks before it acts.
  deploy    ship a service

Flags:
  -h, --help    print help

Output:
  Flags that shape what ops prints.
  -v, --verbose         say more (repeatable)
      --color string    when to color (default auto) [auto|always|never]

Environment:
  OPS_TOKEN string    the API token (length >= 20)

Configuration:
  region (region) string    the default region
